title: Phase C — goal/agent-context authority boundary: non-authoritative sections may never mint Goal Contract requirements
description: ROOT CAUSE on BASE 3737fc4: boundMissionGoal composes a delegated mission goal as '[BUSINESS …]' provenance + operator goal + an appended '[AGENT CONTEXT — last N outcomes]' section of history bullets. extractGoalContract parsed the whole enriched string, so a history bullet leading with a work verb ('- [delegated] Fetch and save GitHub Zen response') minted fabricated OBL_*/DEL_* requirements — observed live as OBL_001 'save GitHub Zen response' + DEL out.md/summary.txt → assertPlanCoverage FAIL_CLOSED_PLAN_INCOMPLETE → PLANNER_RUN_EXHAUSTED → Objective INTEGRITY_FAULT. FIX (structural, not lexical): extractGoalContract now derives requirements only from authoritativeGoalText() — the blank-line-separated first block (operator-authored text) plus any later block that is not a pure '[HEADER] + bullets' metadata section; whole-line bracketed section headers never mint requirements anywhere. The enriched goal still reaches the LLM prompt verbatim as supporting context; mission.goal text, goal_digest, plan digests, pinned plans, retry/idempotency, and fail-closed coverage semantics are unchanged — the same coverage machinery now sees the correct authority scope. detectTelegramDeliveryIntent/detectOutputLanguage call sites in serve-planner and mission-control (mission preview + confirm) evaluate the same authoritative projection so context notes cannot mint delivery intent or flip output language. boundMissionGoal collapses embedded whitespace inside emitted notes so the metadata section stays structurally bullet-only. Regressions pin: bare goals unchanged; bare vs enriched goals mint identical requirements; multiple EN/VI history notes mint nothing; genuine operator obligations/deliverables/prohibitions still mint and still fail closed when uncovered; the enriched text remains available to the planner prompt.
